name: Aegiochusmon: Holy
look: Aegiochusmon in white and gold holy armour with golden gear gauntlets, a halo and a sun of golden spikes behind it
entry: Aegiochusmon in holy armour of golden gears, a halo over its horns and a sun blazing behind it. Its light drives off the darkness and heals those who fight beside it.
how: Wild: rare in hills, plains and forests.
